findings.what: Quote action calls service.Get then service.QuoteCancellation: two loads and two UK-today reads per request; quotedOn and the CANCEL-3 check can disagree across midnight.
findings.why: api.md Conventions: 'Today is UkCalendar.Today(TimeProvider), Europe/London, computed once per request.' quotedOn comes from Get's today (PolicyDetails.Today, a member added beyond the binding signatures.md PolicyDetails(Policy, CurrentTerm, Status)), while the default date and the CANCEL-3 past-date check use a second today read inside QuoteCancellation. PolicyServiceQuoteTests.Quote_reads_the_clock_once proves one read per service call, not per request.

findings.what: PolicyMappings.ToQuote re-implements Policy.Cancel rules in the Api: top-level rule from CurrentTerm and refunds only for a paid term above 0 (no £0 refund).
findings.why: code-quality: 'Rules live in the domain. Controllers map HTTP to the service and back.' COULD-1: 'A read-only version of the cancel calculation'. The refund-eligibility rule (requirements 'No £0 refunds' / CANCEL-2) and the top-level ruleApplied choice now exist both in Policy.Cancel (Policy.cs) and in this mapping. They agree today (CancellationQuoteTests.Quote_and_a_later_cancel_for_the_same_date_agree), but a change to one won't reach the other.

findings.what: RecordClaim action re-reads the policy after saving and treats the last claim as the new one; a concurrent claim in between is returned instead, and stored.Value is unchecked.
findings.why: The service already returns the recorded Claim, but the action does a second load (and a second UK-today read) to find the claim number from Claims.Count. Another claim saved between the two calls would make E5 return that claim's reference, date and description (api.md E5 ClaimResponse). If the re-read fails, stored.Value throws and the request becomes a 500 instead of a ProblemDetails.

findings.what: Policy.Restore gained optional claims/cancellation defaults that only test builders use; signatures.md makes both required and the one src caller passes both.
findings.why: signatures.md (binding): Restore(..., IReadOnlyList<Claim> claims, Cancellation? cancellation). The only src caller (PolicyRecordMapper.cs:18) passes both. The '= null' defaults serve only Domain/Services/Api test builders that omit them. code-quality slop list: speculative generality, and a production signature bent for tests.
